newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends up, RBI continues buying dollars.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends up, RBI continues buying dollars.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.72/73 per dollar on Tuesday, up from the day's opening quote of 35.74/77 rupees, dealers said.
They said the rupee appreciated soon after opening because of poor corporate demand for dollars. The Reserve Bank of India continued to buy dollars at 35.73 level, dealers said.
Most of the day's business was at 35.73 level, they said.
The forward dollar market did not see much action with premia moving in a narrow range, dealers said.
